2608.21117.title: Root cause analysis via difference graph discovery from linear time-series data
2608.21117.paper_summary: Root cause analysis aims to identify the mechanisms responsible for anomalies in complex dynamical systems. In this paper, we study root cause analysis in linear time-series through the lens of difference graph discovery. We focus on effect-defying root causes, corresponding to variables whose causal coefficients change between a normal and an anomalous regime. We formalize this problem using linear discrete-time dynamic structural causal models and adapt several methods originally introduced for discovering difference graphs between two populations to the time-series setting, where the two populations are replaced by a normal and an anomalous regime. We first evaluate the proposed approaches on simulated data, and then demonstrate their practical relevance on real-world datasets from IT monitoring and intensive care monitoring. Our results show how difference graph discovery can help localize causal mechanisms responsible for anomalous behavior.
2608.21117.paper_summary_zh: 根本原因分析旨在識別複雜動態系統中異常的機制。<lb/>在本文中，我們通過差異圖發現的視角研究線性時間序列中的根本原因分析。<lb/>我們專注於違反效應的根本原因，這些原因對應於其因果係數在正常和異常狀態之間變化的變量。<lb/>我們使用線性離散時間動態結構因果模型對這個問題進行形式化，並將幾種最初為發現兩個群體之間的差異圖而引入的方法調整到時間序列的設置中，其中兩個群體由正常和異常狀態取代。<lb/>我們首先在模擬數據上評估所提出的方法，然後在來自IT監控和重症監護監控的實際數據集上展示其實際相關性。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，差異圖發現如何幫助定位導致異常行為的因果機制。
